title: Ukrainian Eggplant Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful stir fry featuring eggplant and Ukrainian dumplings. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the ultra-cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the crispy garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the eggplant and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the Ukrainian dumplings and stir to combine.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the dumplings are heated through.
